🎯 Bangladesh 5 Climate Vulnerability Archetypes (K-Means Clustering)

Radar Fingerprint of Regional Climate Vulnerabilities
1. Severe Coastal Belt (Chattogram, Cox's Bazar, Noakhali): High cyclonic storm surge, salinity intrusion, lowest elevation (3-8m AMSL).
2. Haor Depression Basin (Sylhet, Sunamganj, Netrokona): Extreme flash flood vulnerability, heavy water recurrence (JRC >80%), rapid road cut-off.
3. Active River Diluvion Corridor (Sirajganj, Kurigram, Bogura): Massive riverbank scouring, alluvial char erosion, high displacement rates.
4. Urban Drainage Paralysis (Dhaka, Gazipur, Narayanganj): Impervious concrete surfaces (>85%), stormwater congestion, high asset value loss.
5. High Barind Drought-Prone (Rajshahi, Naogaon, Chapainawabganj): High summer heatwaves, dry soil moisture, groundwater depletion.
